the copy keeps the windows and drops the zone they are written in. Every window is a wall-clock time resolved in the profile's zone, so the copy enforces the same text at the offset between the two zones -- 21:00 in UTC is 23:00 in Europe/Paris -- and the row looks identical to the profile it came from. The test re-zones the source first, because a fixture already at UTC cannot tell a carried zone from a hardcoded one. TestACopyCarriesTheWindowsAndTheZoneAndNoAccounts.

a copy of a profile that does not exist stops being a 404. the create form stops refusing a blank name.
